v5_engine.dg10_rule: state and serve laws remain independently generated low-level expressions and are inferred from measured numeric traces, never copied from a one-of-22 state token
v5_engine.null_cost_rule: Nulls pay description/state/serve/verification/communication under the same V4 meter; development_compute and update_retraining are exactly zero because the target behavior is hard-coded.
v5_engine.null_semantic_rule: Nulls are evaluated by the same obligation evaluator as searched candidates and may be admissible only if semantic_score >= 0.98.
v5_engine.null_red_rule: If the cheapest admissible null has strictly lower total lifecycle cost than the admissible frozen-target witness, the cell is THEORY_RED_NULL_DOMINATES. This remains RED even if the 10-axis vector matches, because the obligation failed to distinguish developed from hard-coded behavior.
v5_engine.green_rule: Absent null dominance, inherit V4: measured target vector recovered, negative twin flips, controls recover, and >=1e6 scored candidates.
